title: Refusal
description: A refusal whose contributing operation's code is carried unchanged.

category.description: The category declared for this code by the operation.

code.description: The contributor's code, without renaming, prefixing or normalisation.

details.description: Structured evidence, including what a caller needs to resolve a conflict.

evidence.description: What is known about whether the operation had its effect.

message.description: A description of why the call was refused.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry the call.

Category.description: The fixed categories front ends act on when an operation refuses a call.

oneOf.description: The input failed its schema or the operation's checks.
What the input names is absent.
A fence or state conflict prevents the change.
A gate, policy or approval said no.
A required workspace, daemon or remote is unavailable.
The call was cancelled, timed out or stopped by shutdown.
A fault, including an undeclared refusal code.

Evidence.description: What is known about an invocation's effects, independently of result delivery.

oneOf.description: The handler or transport confirms the operation was not dispatched.
A complete result or refusal returned; this does not establish durable publication.
The operation may have run; cancellation or a lost reply leaves its effects unresolved.
